title: Inverse Scattering from Conformal Infinity for Totally Geodesic Defects in Hyperbolic Space
summary: We study inverse scattering from conformal infinity for impenetrable topological defects whose interaction surfaces are totally geodesic in hyperbolic space \(\mathbb H^n\), \(n \geq 2\). For a fixed spectral parameter \(λ_0 > 0\), the prescribed inputs are boundary labels \(ξ\in \partial_\infty \mathbb H^n\). Each label selects an incoming Helgason mode in the hyperbolic interior. Given a defect \(\mathcal P \Subset \mathbb H^n\), this mode generally fails to satisfy the homogeneous trace condition on the interaction surface and hence generates an outgoing correction.
